name: Torn Fin Eye
summary: Along Hillsbrad's coast, Torn Fin Eyes draw the Royal Apothecary Society's attention. The Forsaken seek them for alchemical work on new plagues.

sections.title: A Reagent for Ruin
sections.body: The Royal Apothecary Society puts rare biological components to use in its work on the Forsaken's New Plague. Torn Fin Eyes come from murlocs along the Western Strand of Hillsbrad Foothills. Their organic properties help activate volatile alchemical compounds. Mixed with Daggerspine naga scales, restorative troll elixirs, and gnoll-derived sludge, the eyes help stabilize and trigger toxic mixtures meant to spread death through enemy lands.

sections.title: Brewing Agony
sections.body: In the Undercity's Apothecarium, master alchemists found that decaying colloids added to Mudsnout composites need catalysts from Hillsbrad's coast. Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill uses the harvested eyes to catalyze his Elixir of Agony. The brew is part of the Forsaken's continuing effort to make devastating bio-weapons near human settlements.

faq.q: What is a Torn Fin Eye used for?
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society seeks Torn Fin Eyes as an alchemical catalyst. In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon combines them with Daggerspine Scales and a Strong Troll's Blood Elixir to activate contaminants in a volatile Mudsnout Mixture and advance his work on deadly plagues.

faq.q: Where do you find Torn Fin Eyes?
aliases: where to get torn fin eyes
faq.answer: You can harvest Torn Fin Eyes from Torn Fin murlocs on the Western Strand of Hillsbrad Foothills, along the coast west of Southshore.

faq.q: Who orders the gathering of these eyes?
faq.answer: Forsaken researchers in the Undercity and Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill need the eyes to complete the Elixir of Agony.

faq.q: Why does the Royal Apothecary Society need murloc parts?
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society studies local creatures for compounds that activate or intensify toxic contaminants. Torn Fin murloc ocular humors can catalyze volatile plague prototypes.

angles.text: As an Undead, gathering organic catalysts like Torn Fin Eyes advances the Royal Apothecary Society's aim to perfect a plague that will destroy both the Scourge and the living.
As a member of the Horde, you help its war effort in Hillsbrad Foothills by gathering coastal reagents, strengthening the Forsaken foothold against Alliance advances from Southshore.
